items.h: Metaplanet equity backlash, SE Asia crypto funding doubles: Asia Express
items.s: Shareholders of Bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet are seething over equity allocations for insiders, while new figures cement Singapore’s role as the top Asian crypto hub.
